from pandas.core.arrays.arrow import ArrowDtype

probe('concat_time64_dtype', str(result_time64.dtype))

# Test 5: concat with decimal128

result_decimal = pd.concat([ser_decimal, null_ser], ignore_index=True)
probe('concat_decimal_dtype', str(result_decimal.dtype))

# Test 6: concat with binary
ser_binary = pd.Series([None], dtype=ArrowDtype(pa.binary()))
result_binary = pd.concat([ser_binary, null_ser], ignore_index=True)
probe('concat_binary_dtype', str(result_binary.dtype))

# Test 7: concat with large_string

result_large_string = pd.concat([ser_large_string, null_ser], ignore_index=True)
probe('concat_large_string_dtype', str(result_large_string.dtype))

# Test 8: concat with list

import pandas as pd
from pandas.core.dtypes.dtypes import ArrowDtype

# Test 1: ArrowDtype._get_common_dtype combining date32 / date64 with null[pyarrow]
try:
    dtype_date32 = ArrowDtype(pa.date32())
    dtype_date64 = ArrowDtype(pa.date64())
    dtype_null = ArrowDtype(pa.null())
    
    result1 = dtype_date32._get_common_dtype([dtype_date32, dtype_null])
    probe("ArrowDtype._get_common_dtype combining date32 / date64 with null[pyarrow]", result1)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("ArrowDtype._get_common_dtype combining date32 / date64 with null[pyarrow]", e)

# Test 2: ArrowDtype._get_common_dtype combining timestamp[us, tz=US/Pacific] with null[pyarrow]

    dtype_timestamp = ArrowDtype(pa.timestamp('us', tz='US/Pacific'))

    probe_exception("ArrowDtype._get_common_dtype combining timestamp[us, tz=US/Pacific] with null[pyarrow]", e)
